summary: CCH Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K to disclose a notice convening an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 03, 2026, at its principal executive office in Malaysia. The filing attaches the EGM notice, proxy statement, form of proxy, and a proposed Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, with no specific transaction or special situation described. The matter relates to routine corporate governance changes, including updates to authorized share capital and class designations. This is an ordinary meeting notice rather than a special-situation event, warranting categorization as 'None.'
